root: ^Molok: All I ever wanted was to see my brother alive.
^ I did not deserve this fate.
^Cacildes: What will happen to the elves if I shatter this stone?
^Molok: The elves, you ask? They chose to build their paradise on my suffering.
^ Every tree that sprouts, every grape that feeds their wine, year after year — borne of my pain.
^Molok: The elves... I do not seek revenge, but neither will I mourn what they lose.
^ This stone must be shattered. I must be free — for my people.
^Molok: Look... the crack is beginning to heal. Strike now, mortal—
^ or we’ll be sealed within this prison forever!
